gate: G5 — Case files, drafting, DOCX export

demo_motion.title: Regulatory taking, just compensation
demo_motion.source: G3 live run 2026-08-30 (Lucas / Tahoe-Sierra); no new LLM run needed — export is deterministic over the stored draft
demo_motion.resolve_gate: 4/4 citations resolve (505 U.S. 1003, 535 U.S. 302 + sentence pins); 0 unresolvable
demo_motion.docx_checks: zip valid; banner present; both appendix citations present; one paragraph per sentence (no embedded newlines); strike probe on synthetic draft: exactly 1 true <w:strike/> on the unverified sentence, 0 w:val="false" leftovers, UNVERIFIED marker present

http_end_to_end.export_200: GET /api/cases/32/export → 200, content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, attachment filename alex-case-32-regulatory-taking-just-compensation.docx, valid .docx bytes
http_end_to_end.persistence: documents row (kind='motion', plain-text body) + audit_log drafter.export row, both scoped to case 32
http_end_to_end.refusal_404: GET /api/cases/999999/export → 404 no drafted run for case
http_end_to_end.refusal_409: scratch case with fabricated appendix cite '494 U.S. 560' (real Muniz cite is 496 U.S. 582) → 409 with unresolvable list; zero documents/audit side effects; scratch rows deleted after

implementation.exporter: app/lib/export_docx.ts — pure planMotionParagraphs() (unit-tested) + thin buildMotionDocx() over the canon-confirmed docx lib; banner first in code (§11); unverified sentences kept struck-through (§3); inferred sentences italic (§5.5)
implementation.route: app/app/api/cases/[id]/export/route.ts — fail-closed resolve gate over appendix + pin cites (case parse → resolveCluster, statute parse → resolveStatute), then build + persist + stream
implementation.ui: Export .docx button beside Copy draft in the Result header; 409 detail renders inline
implementation.runner: evals/run_g5.ts (pnpm g5) — same gate offline, writes logs/g5-motion.docx

scope_notes: DOCX only. No PDF path: react-pdf silently ignores whiteSpace: pre-wrap (noted in the G5 gate row), and no failing eval case demands a second format (§2).
Export refuses drafts with unresolvable citations (409) rather than emitting them; struck-through UNVERIFIED sentences without a citation form still export, mirroring the UI.
